# dagsterplus_secret (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ environment secret by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_secret" "my_api_key" {
  secret_name = "MY_API_KEY"
}

output "secret_id" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_secret.my_api_key.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_name` (String) The name of the secret to look up.

### Read-Only

- `all_branch_deployments_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to all branch deployments.
- `full_deployment_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to the full deployment.
- `id` (String) The secret ID assigned by Dagster+.
- `local_deployment_scope` (Boolean) Whether the secret is available to local deployments.
- `location_names` (List of String) Code location names the secret is scoped to.
- `secret_value` (String, Sensitive) The value of the secret.
- `specific_branch_deployment_scope` (String) A specific branch deployment name the secret is scoped to.
